# Sources and Frameworks

This skill is built upon established agile and discovery practices.

## Frameworks
- **BDD-style Acceptance Criteria**: Developed by Dan North, using the GIVEN/WHEN/THEN format to ensure objective and testable results.
- **INVEST Heuristic**: Developed by Bill Wake to evaluate the quality of a user story.
  - **I**ndependent
  - **N**egotiable
  - **V**aluable
  - **E**stimable
  - **S**mall
  - **T**estable
- **Fibonacci Story-Point Estimation**: Used for relative sizing based on complexity, effort, and uncertainty.
- **Scrum Definition of Ready / Definition of Done**: Industry standards for determining when work can start and when it is finished.
